candidate.answerReason: One whole contains 10 tenths. Dividing those equally between two parts gives 5 tenths per part, or 0.5.

methods.label: Equal sharing in tenths
methods.explanation: If 1 cake is divided into 2 equal parts, each part is \(1/2\). One whole is 10 tenths, so each part contains \(10\div2=5\) tenths. Therefore, \(1\div2=0.5\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 3 tenths and earlier equal-sharing and division facts.
